scope: 16-spin zero-field Curie-Weiss shared conditional generators; new evidence only after final fitting

vae.loss: standard ELBO of symmetrized Bernoulli decoder; fixed N(0,1) prior; one reparameterized latent draw per observation; log variance clipped [-12,12]

conditioning: raw scalar beta; affine bias conditioning for RBM, affine embedding for Transformer, concatenation for VAE
symmetry: q_sym(x|beta)=(q(x|beta)+q(complement(x)|beta))/2; trained and sampled consistently; no permutation projection

training.target_pool: same parent seed streams, target generator, draw counts and per-repeat pool reuse; pair across capacities and families
training.optimizer: Adam, no weight decay or gradient clipping
training.objectives: native likelihood/ELBO; target exact probabilities excluded from training

search.sampler: locked Optuna5.0.0; sequential ask/tell per study; multivariate TPE, 24 EI candidates, 60 startup trials, constant_liar=True, NopPruner
search.initialization: architecture-appropriate Xavier weight initialization scaled by multiplier; zero biases and unit LayerNorm gains
search.phase_execution: each CLI stage explicit; random and TPE finish at review barriers
search.sampler_seed_policy: random sampler per family/capacity; TPE sampler reconstructed per proposal with seed derived from family/capacity/proposal index, giving deterministic resume without serializing executable sampler state

selection: inherit parent J/P, tolerance0.01 and global checkpoint/start selection on A; shortlist3-4; confirmation on A union B; no B checkpoint selection; no further HPO after confirmation; final ten fresh repeats and three starts

evaluation.grid: parent exact A/B/F grids and common markers
evaluation.aggregation: per-fit metrics first; all repeats retained; mean and sample standard deviation; no fitted-model ensembles

vae_quadrature.error_label: numerical integration, successive-refinement diagnostic; not a certified error bound

evaluation.sampling_timing: one warmup batch then timed batch of same shape; compilation retained separately

failures: numerical failures count as screening proposals with J=1 flagged as penalty, not measured TVD; no replacement seeds; confirmation/final numerical failures block stage completion; infrastructure interruptions propagate and resume identical jobs
reproducibility: immutable source/environment/protocol identity; hash all fit artifacts and target pools; complete checkpoint parameters, loss trajectories and fit receipts; incomplete starts may rerun with same identity and seeds
reporting: write ignored results only; final curves and summaries do not replace paper artifacts; smoke uses n4 and reduced budgets, labelled non-evidence
claim_scope: small-system conditional accuracy and learned parameter efficiency; not a classical sampling advantage; record designed IQP encoder priors and training versus generation parameter counts
development_history: classical design accepted after existing IQP final results; freeze before inspecting classical final-grid results
